environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with standard pg_hba.conf allowing md5 auth from VPC CIDR. No reverse proxy, no WAF, no middleware adding security headers. Service listens directly on port 8080, NLB forwards TCP:443 -> TCP:8080. TLS terminated at NLB.

config.security_headers: none (application does not set CSP or other headers)
config.network: VPC with public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 443
